title: More listening: words, sentences and dialogues

items.audioText: live

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: live (לגור, לחיות) נשמעת עם i קצרה. leave (לעזוב) עם ee ארוכה. life (חיים) נגמרת בצליל f.
explanation.en: live has a short i. leave has a long ee. life ends with an f sound.

items.audioText: fool

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: fool (טיפש) נשמעת עם oo ארוכה. full (מלא) עם u קצרה. fall (ליפול) עם צליל o פתוח.
explanation.en: fool has a long oo. full has a short u. fall has an open aw sound.

items.audioText: walk

hints.he: האם שומעים r באמצע? איזה צליל יש אחרי w?
hints.en: Do you hear an r? What sound comes after w?

explanation.he: walk (ללכת) נשמעת כמו "ווֹק", וה־l לא נשמעת. work (לעבוד) נשמעת עם צליל er, כמו "ווֶרְק". woke (התעוררתי) נשמעת כמו "ווֹאוּק".
explanation.en: walk sounds like "wawk" (silent l). work has an er sound. woke has an oh sound.

items.audioText: cap

hints.he: הפה פתוח לרוחב או מעט?
hints.en: Is the mouth wide open or only a little?

explanation.he: cap (כובע מצחייה) נשמעת עם a פתוחה, בין "א" ל"אֶ". cup (כוס) עם צליל קצר כמו "אַ" סגור. cop (שוטר) עם o.
explanation.en: cap has a wide a sound. cup has a short uh. cop has an o sound.

items.audioText: thank

hints.he: איך מתחילה המילה? הלשון בין השיניים?
hints.en: How does the word start? Is the tongue between the teeth?

explanation.he: thank (להודות) מתחילה ב־th: הלשון בין השיניים והאוויר עובר. tank (מכל, טנק) מתחילה ב־t, ו־sank (שקע) ב־s.
explanation.en: thank starts with th: the tongue is between the teeth. tank starts with t, sank with s.

items.audioText: they

hints.he: איך מתחילה המילה? הלשון בין השיניים?
hints.en: How does the word start? Is the tongue between the teeth?

explanation.he: they (הם, הן) מתחילה ב־th רכה: הלשון בין השיניים ויש זמזום. day (יום) מתחילה ב־d חדה. say (לומר) ב־s.
explanation.en: they starts with a soft th, with the tongue between the teeth. day starts with a hard d, say with s.

items.audioText: free

hints.he: איך מתחילה המילה? השפתיים או הלשון?
hints.en: How does the word start? Lips or tongue?

explanation.he: free (חופשי, חינם) מתחילה ב־f: השיניים על השפה התחתונה. three (שלוש) מתחילה ב־th והלשון בין השיניים. tree (עץ) ב־t.
explanation.en: free starts with f (teeth on the lower lip). three starts with th, tree with t.

items.audioText: fit

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: fit (מתאים, בכושר) נשמעת עם i קצרה. feet (רגליים) עם ee ארוכה. fat (שמן) עם a פתוחה.
explanation.en: fit has a short i. feet has a long ee. fat has a wide a.

items.audioText: slip

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: slip (להחליק) נשמעת עם i קצרה. sleep (לישון) עם ee ארוכה. slap (סטירה) עם a פתוחה.
explanation.en: slip has a short i. sleep has a long ee. slap has a wide a.

items.audioText: pan

hints.he: הפה פתוח לרוחב או מעט?
hints.en: Is the mouth wide open or only a little?

explanation.he: pan (מחבת) נשמעת עם a פתוחה ורחבה. pen (עט) עם e כמו "אֶ". pin (סיכה) עם i קצרה.
explanation.en: pan has a wide a. pen has an e sound. pin has a short i.

items.audioText: luck

hints.he: איזה צליל באמצע: אַ קצר, אוֹ, או אֶ פתוח?
hints.en: Which middle sound: uh, o, or a wide a?

explanation.he: luck (מזל) נשמעת עם צליל קצר כמו "לַק". lock (מנעול) עם o. lack (חוסר) עם a פתוחה ורחבה.
explanation.en: luck has a short uh. lock has an o sound. lack has a wide a.

items.audioText: shirt

hints.he: האם שומעים צליל er באמצע?
hints.en: Do you hear an er sound in the middle?

explanation.he: shirt (חולצה) נשמעת עם צליל er, כמו "שֶרְט". short (קצר) עם צליל אוֹ ארוך. shut (לסגור) עם צליל קצר כמו "שַט".
explanation.en: shirt has an er sound. short has a long or sound. shut has a short uh.

items.audioText: bought

hints.he: הצליל באמצע אחיד, או שהוא זז מ"אוֹ" ל"אוּ"?
hints.en: Is the middle sound steady, or does it glide from oh to oo?

explanation.he: bought (קניתי) נשמעת עם צליל אוֹ פתוח ואחיד, וה־gh לא נשמעות. boat (סירה) גולשת מ"אוֹ" ל"אוּ". but (אבל) עם צליל קצר כמו "בַּט".
explanation.en: bought has an open aw sound (gh is silent). boat glides like oh-oo. but has a short uh.

items.audioText: vest

hints.he: השיניים נוגעות בשפה, או שהשפתיים עגולות?
hints.en: Do the teeth touch the lip, or are the lips round?

explanation.he: vest (גופייה, אפוד) מתחילה ב־v: השיניים העליונות על השפה התחתונה. west (מערב) מתחילה ב־w עם שפתיים עגולות. best (הכי טוב) ב־b.
explanation.en: vest starts with v (teeth on the lip). west starts with w (round lips). best starts with b.

items.audioText: foot

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: foot (כף רגל) נשמעת עם u קצרה. food (אוכל) עם oo ארוכה. feet (רגליים, ברבים) עם ee.
explanation.en: foot has a short u. food has a long oo. feet has an ee sound.

items.audioText: heel

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: heel (עקב) נשמעת עם ee ארוכה. hill (גבעה) עם i קצרה. hall (אולם, מסדרון) עם צליל אוֹ.
explanation.en: heel has a long ee. hill has a short i. hall has an aw sound.

items.audioText: thing

hints.he: איך מתחילה המילה, ואיך היא נגמרת?
hints.en: How does the word start, and how does it end?

explanation.he: thing (דבר) מתחילה ב־th ונגמרת ב־ng בלי k. sing (לשיר) מתחילה ב־s. think (לחשוב) נגמרת בצליל k ברור.
explanation.en: thing starts with th and ends with ng, no k. sing starts with s. think ends with a clear k.

items.audioText: warm

hints.he: הצליל באמצע הוא "אוֹ" או er?
hints.en: Is the middle sound or or er?

explanation.he: warm (חמים) נשמעת עם צליל אוֹ, כמו "ווֹרְם". worm (תולעת) עם צליל er, כמו "ווֶרְם". word (מילה) נגמרת ב־d.
explanation.en: warm sounds like "wawm". worm has an er sound. word ends with d.

items.audioText: hurt

hints.he: הצליל באמצע הוא er או "אָה" פתוח?
hints.en: Is the middle sound er or an open ah?

explanation.he: hurt (לכאוב, לפגוע) נשמעת עם צליל er, כמו "הֶרְט". heart (לב) עם "אָה" ארוך ופתוח. hot (חם) עם o קצרה.
explanation.en: hurt has an er sound. heart has a long ah. hot has a short o.

items.audioText: cheap

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: cheap (זול) נשמעת עם ee ארוכה. chip (צ'יפס, שבב) עם i קצרה. chop (לקצוץ) עם o.
explanation.en: cheap has a long ee. chip has a short i. chop has an o sound.

items.prompt: How much is the T-shirt today?
items.audioText: This T-shirt usually costs fifty shekels, but today it's ten shekels cheaper.

hints.he: להקשיב למה שקורה today.
hints.en: Listen for what happens today.

explanation.he: בדרך כלל usually costs fifty shekels, אבל היום ten shekels cheaper: עשרה שקלים פחות. 50 פחות 10 זה 40.
explanation.en: It usually costs 50, but today it is 10 shekels cheaper: 50 - 10 = 40.

items.audioText: The bus to Haifa leaves at a quarter to seven, so don't be late.

hints.he: a quarter to זה לפני השעה או אחריה?
hints.en: Is a quarter to before or after the hour?

explanation.he: a quarter to seven פירושו רבע לשבע: 6:45. רבע אחרי שבע זה a quarter past seven.
explanation.en: A quarter to seven is 6:45. A quarter past seven is 7:15.

items.prompt: How many students are in class today?
items.audioText: There are thirty students in our class, but four of them are sick today.

hints.he: כמה תלמידים חסרים היום?
hints.en: How many students are missing today?

explanation.he: יש thirty students, ו־four of them are sick: ארבעה חולים. 30 פחות 4 זה 26.
explanation.en: There are 30 students and 4 are sick, so 26 are in class.

items.prompt: Who teaches at the speaker's school?
items.audioText: My aunt is a nurse, and her husband teaches maths at my school.

hints.he: her husband: הבעל של מי?
hints.en: her husband: whose husband?

explanation.he: הדודה היא nurse (אחות). her husband, הבעל של הדודה, הוא הדוד, והוא teaches maths at my school.
explanation.en: The aunt is a nurse. Her husband, the uncle, teaches at the school.

items.audioText: I left my glasses next to the computer in Dad's office.

hints.he: להקשיב למילה שבאה אחרי in.
hints.en: Listen for the word after in.

explanation.he: הדובר/ת אומר/ת next to the computer in Dad's office: ליד המחשב בחדר העבודה של אבא.
explanation.en: The glasses are next to the computer in Dad's office.

items.audioText: My birthday is on the twelfth of May, two days after my brother's.

hints.he: two days after: יום ההולדת של מי בא קודם?
hints.en: two days after: whose birthday comes first?

explanation.he: יום ההולדת של הדובר/ת ב־12 במאי, two days after my brother's: יומיים אחרי של האח. לכן לאח יש יום הולדת ב־10 במאי.
explanation.en: The speaker's birthday (May 12th) is two days after the brother's, so his is on May 10th.

items.prompt: How long is the bike ride to the pool?
items.audioText: The swimming pool is fifteen minutes from our house by bike.

hints.he: fifteen או fifty? להקשיב לסוף המילה.
hints.en: fifteen or fifty? Listen to the end of the word.

explanation.he: שומעים fifteen, עם teen ארוך ומודגש בסוף: 15. fifty (50) נגמרת ב־ty קצר.
explanation.en: fifteen has a long, stressed teen at the end. fifty ends with a short ty.

items.audioText: Can you turn the music down a little? I'm trying to study.

hints.he: turn down: להגביר או להנמיך?
hints.en: turn down: louder or quieter?

explanation.he: turn the music down פירושו להנמיך את המוזיקה. הדובר/ת רוצה שקט כי I'm trying to study.
explanation.en: turn the music down = make it quieter. The speaker wants less noise to study.

items.prompt: What did the speaker eat this morning?
items.audioText: For breakfast I usually have eggs, but this morning I only had a banana.

hints.he: להקשיב למה שקרה this morning.
hints.en: Listen for what happened this morning.

explanation.he: usually have eggs זה מה שקורה בדרך כלל. אבל this morning I only had a banana: הבוקר רק בננה.
explanation.en: Eggs are usual. This morning the speaker only had a banana.

items.prompt: When does the lesson end today?
items.audioText: The lesson usually ends at two, but today it finishes an hour early.

hints.he: an hour early: לפני השעה הרגילה או אחריה?
hints.en: an hour early: before or after the usual time?

explanation.he: בדרך כלל ends at two. היום an hour early: שעה מוקדם יותר. כלומר באחת.
explanation.en: Usually at two, but today an hour early, so at one.

items.prompt: How much do a sandwich and a drink cost together?
items.audioText: A sandwich costs eighteen shekels, and a drink costs seven.

hints.he: לחבר את שני המחירים.
hints.en: Add the two prices.

explanation.he: sandwich costs eighteen (18) ו־a drink costs seven (7). ביחד 18 ועוד 7 זה 25.
explanation.en: 18 + 7 = 25 shekels.

items.audioText: Noa is the girl with long red hair, sitting next to the window.

options.text: The girl with long red hair
The girl with short red hair
The girl next to the door

hints.he: להקשיב לתיאור השיער ולמקום.
hints.en: Listen to the hair and the place.

explanation.he: נועה היא the girl with long red hair: שיער ארוך ואדום, sitting next to the window: ליד החלון.
explanation.en: Noa has long red hair and sits next to the window.

items.audioText: Don't forget your hat. It's really hot and sunny outside.

hints.he: Don't forget... זו בקשה, התנצלות או עצה?
hints.en: Don't forget... is it a request, an apology or advice?

explanation.he: Don't forget your hat: לא לשכוח כובע, כי hot and sunny. הדובר/ת נותן/ת עצה.
explanation.en: Don't forget your hat because it's sunny: the speaker is giving advice.

items.prompt: What are the last four digits of the number?
items.audioText: My number is zero five two, three four eight, six six one nine.

hints.he: להקשיב לחלק האחרון, ספרה אחרי ספרה.
hints.en: Listen to the last part, digit by digit.

explanation.he: החלק האחרון הוא six six one nine: 6619. כדאי לכתוב ספרה אחרי ספרה בזמן ההקשבה.
explanation.en: The last part is six six one nine: 6619.

items.audioText: Dan's sister is a doctor, and his brother works in a bank. Their mother used to be a pilot.

hints.he: להקשיב למי שבא לפני works in a bank.
hints.en: Listen for who comes before works in a bank.

explanation.he: his brother works in a bank: האח של דן עובד בבנק. האחות היא doctor, והאמא used to be a pilot.
explanation.en: Dan's brother works in a bank. His sister is a doctor, and his mother used to be a pilot.

items.audioText: I'm afraid we're fully booked tonight, but I could give you a table for tomorrow.

options.text: Someone who works at a restaurant

hints.he: מי יכול לתת a table?
hints.en: Who can give someone a table?

explanation.he: we're fully booked (הכול תפוס) ו־I could give you a table (אני יכול/ה לתת לך שולחן): זה מה שאומר מי שעובד במסעדה.
explanation.en: Only someone working at the restaurant can say "we're fully booked" and offer a table.

items.audioText: Please fasten your seat belts. We'll be landing in about twenty minutes.

hints.he: איזה כלי תחבורה עושה landing?
hints.en: Which kind of transport does landing?

explanation.he: landing פירושו נחיתה. רק מטוס נוחת, לכן הדובר/ת on a plane.
explanation.en: landing means coming down to the ground. Only a plane lands.

items.audioText: I was going to cook pasta, but we're out of tomatoes, so I ordered pizza instead.

hints.he: להקשיב למילה instead.
hints.en: Listen for the word instead.

explanation.he: I was going to cook pasta זו התוכנית שלא קרתה, כי we're out of tomatoes (נגמרו העגבניות). so I ordered pizza instead: הזמנתי פיצה במקום.
explanation.en: The pasta plan failed (no tomatoes), so the speaker ordered pizza instead.

items.prompt: How long did the trip take?
items.audioText: The drive usually takes two hours, but because of the traffic, it took us almost twice as long.

hints.he: twice as long: פי כמה?
hints.en: twice as long: how many times longer?

explanation.he: בדרך כלל two hours. בגלל הפקקים almost twice as long: כמעט פי שניים, כלומר כמעט ארבע שעות.
explanation.en: twice as long as two hours is four hours.

items.audioText: If I were you, I'd talk to the teacher before the test.

hints.he: If I were you: מה אומרים בעברית?
hints.en: If I were you: what does it mean in Hebrew?

explanation.he: If I were you, I'd... פירושו "במקומך הייתי...". זו הדרך הרגילה לתת עצה.
explanation.en: "If I were you, I'd..." is a common way to give advice.

items.audioText: Sorry I'm late. The bus broke down halfway here.

hints.he: מה אומרים בהתחלה, ומה אחר כך?
hints.en: What comes first, and what comes next?

explanation.he: Sorry I'm late זו התנצלות. The bus broke down (האוטובוס התקלקל) זה ההסבר.
explanation.en: "Sorry I'm late" is an apology. "The bus broke down" is the explanation.

items.audioText: The school trip has been postponed. Instead of this Sunday, it'll be a week later.

hints.he: postponed: הוקדם או נדחה?
hints.en: postponed: earlier or later?

explanation.he: postponed פירושו נדחה. Instead of this Sunday, it'll be a week later: במקום ביום ראשון הזה, שבוע אחר כך.
explanation.en: postponed = moved later. It will be a week after this Sunday.

items.prompt: How much did the speaker pay for the shoes?
items.audioText: These shoes were two hundred shekels, but I got them for half price in the sale.

hints.he: half price: איזה חלק מהמחיר?
hints.en: half price: what part of the price?

explanation.he: המחיר היה two hundred (200), וקניתי half price: חצי מחיר. חצי מ־200 זה 100.
explanation.en: Half of 200 is 100.

items.audioText: I'll be there at ten past five, so wait for me at the entrance.

hints.he: past זה לפני השעה או אחריה?
hints.en: Is past before or after the hour?

explanation.he: ten past five פירושו חמש ועשרה: 5:10. עשרה לחמש זה ten to five (4:50).
explanation.en: ten past five is 5:10. ten to five is 4:50.

items.audioText: Could you possibly lend me your notes from yesterday's lesson? I was absent.

hints.he: lend me: מי נותן ומי מקבל?
hints.en: lend me: who gives and who gets?

explanation.he: lend me your notes: להשאיל לי את הסיכומים. הדובר/ת מקבל/ת, כלומר רוצה to borrow (לשאול). lend זה לתת, borrow זה לקבל.
explanation.en: "Lend me your notes" means the speaker wants to borrow them. lend = give, borrow = take.

items.prompt: How does the speaker feel about the film?
items.audioText: Honestly, I expected the film to be much better. The ending was so predictable.

hints.he: I expected... much better: הסרט היה טוב כמו שחשבו?
hints.en: I expected much better: was the film as good as expected?

explanation.he: I expected the film to be much better: ציפיתי ליותר. The ending was so predictable: היה ברור מה יקרה. זו אכזבה.
explanation.en: The speaker expected more and the ending was predictable: disappointed.

items.audioText: Could I have a return ticket to Tel Aviv, please? On the next train, if possible.

hints.he: להקשיב למילה בסוף.
hints.en: Listen for the word at the end.

explanation.he: a return ticket (כרטיס הלוך ושוב) ו־on the next train: מבקשים כרטיס לרכבת, ולכן זו תחנת רכבת.
explanation.en: Asking for a ticket on the next train: the speaker is at a train station.

items.audioText: I'd love to join you, but I promised to help my grandma move this weekend.

options.text: They don't want to help their grandma.

hints.he: מה בא אחרי but?
hints.en: What comes after but?

explanation.he: I'd love to join you זו פתיחה מנומסת. but I promised to help my grandma: הבטחתי לעזור לסבתא. זה סירוב מנומס.
explanation.en: "I'd love to, but..." is a polite way to say no.

items.prompt: How many people came to the wedding?
items.audioText: There were about sixty people at the wedding, far fewer than we'd expected.

hints.he: sixty או sixteen? להקשיב לסוף המילה.
hints.en: sixty or sixteen? Listen to the end of the word.

explanation.he: שומעים sixty, עם ty קצר והדגש בהתחלה: 60. sixteen (16) נגמרת ב־teen ארוך. far fewer than we'd expected: הרבה פחות ממה שציפו.
explanation.en: sixty has the stress at the start and a short ty: 60.

items.audioText: Let's meet in front of the library at four. It's easier to find than the café.

hints.he: איפה קל יותר למצוא?
hints.en: Which place is easier to find?

explanation.he: Let's meet in front of the library: ניפגש מול הספרייה. בית הקפה מוזכר רק כמקום שקשה יותר למצוא.
explanation.en: They will meet in front of the library. The café is only harder to find.

items.prompt: What will Avi do in the lesson?
items.audioText: Teacher: Please open your books at page forty-two. Avi: Sorry, I left my book at home. Teacher: Then share with Noa today.

options.text: Go home to get his book

hints.he: מה המורה אומר/ת בסוף?
hints.en: What does the teacher say at the end?

explanation.he: אבי שכח את הספר: I left my book at home. המורה אומר/ת Then share with Noa today: היום ישתמש בספר יחד עם נועה.
explanation.en: Avi forgot his book, so the teacher tells him to share with Noa.

items.prompt: What will Shira and Eyal do at the break?
items.audioText: Shira: Did you understand the maths homework? Eyal: Most of it, but I got stuck on the last question. Shira: Me too. Let's ask Ms. Levi at the break.

options.text: Copy the answers from a friend

hints.he: להקשיב למשפט עם Let's.
hints.en: Listen to the sentence with Let's.

explanation.he: שניהם got stuck on the last question (נתקעו בשאלה האחרונה). שירה מציעה Let's ask Ms. Levi at the break: לשאול את המורה בהפסקה.
explanation.en: Both are stuck, so they will ask Ms. Levi, their teacher, at the break.

items.prompt: What can we understand about Ori?
items.audioText: Yael: How did the history test go? Ori: Let's just say I should have studied the last chapter. Yael: Oh no. Was the whole test about that? Ori: About half of it.

options.text: He didn't do well on the test.
He studied the last chapter well.

hints.he: I should have studied: הוא למד את הפרק או לא?
hints.en: I should have studied: did he study it or not?

explanation.he: I should have studied the last chapter פירושו "הייתי צריך ללמוד", כלומר לא למד. חצי מהמבחן היה על הפרק הזה, אז המבחן לא הלך טוב.
explanation.en: "I should have studied" means he didn't. Half the test was on that chapter, so it went badly.

items.audioText: Teacher: Lior, you've handed in your project two days late again. Lior: I know, I'm really sorry. Teacher: I'll accept it this time, but next time I'll take off points.

options.text: Annoyed, but willing to accept it
Too angry to accept the project

hints.he: המורה מקבלת את העבודה או לא?
hints.en: Does the teacher accept the project or not?

explanation.he: המילה again מראה שהמורה לא מרוצה. אבל I'll accept it this time: הפעם העבודה מתקבלת, עם אזהרה לפעם הבאה.
explanation.en: "again" shows the teacher is annoyed, but the project is accepted this time, with a warning.

items.audioText: Noam: Are you running for class president? Hila: I was thinking about it, but I'm not sure I'd have the time. Noam: You'd be great at it. And Dana said she'd help with the posters. Hila: Okay, you've convinced me.

options.text: Not to run for class president
To help Dana with her posters

hints.he: you've convinced me: מה זה אומר?
hints.en: you've convinced me: what does it mean?

explanation.he: בהתחלה הילה לא בטוחה: I'm not sure. בסוף היא אומרת you've convinced me: שכנעת אותי. לכן היא תתמודד.
explanation.en: At the end Hila says "you've convinced me", so she will run.

items.prompt: How much are the cheaper headphones?
items.audioText: Customer: How much are these headphones? Assistant: They're a hundred and twenty shekels. Customer: Hmm, do you have anything cheaper? Assistant: Yes, these are eighty.

hints.he: להקשיב לתשובה האחרונה של המוכר/ת.
hints.en: Listen to the assistant's last answer.

explanation.he: הזוג הראשון עולה a hundred and twenty (120). הלקוח/ה שואל/ת על משהו cheaper, והתשובה: these are eighty (80).
explanation.en: The first pair costs 120. The cheaper ones are eighty: 80.

items.audioText: Customer: I bought this jacket yesterday, but the zip is broken. Assistant: I'm sorry about that. Would you like a new one or your money back? Customer: A new one, please. I really like the colour.

options.text: The same jacket without a broken zip
A jacket in a different colour

hints.he: מה הלקוח/ה בוחר/ת: a new one או money back?
hints.en: What does the customer choose: a new one or the money?

explanation.he: המוכר/ת מציע/ה שתי אפשרויות. הלקוח/ה עונה A new one, please: מעיל חדש מאותו סוג, כי I really like the colour.
explanation.en: The customer wants a new one of the same jacket because they like the colour.

items.audioText: Assistant: Can I help you? Gal: I'm just looking, thanks. Assistant: Sure. The fitting rooms are at the back if you want to try anything on.

hints.he: איפה יש fitting rooms?
hints.en: Where are there fitting rooms?

explanation.he: fitting rooms הם תאי מדידה, ו־try anything on פירושו למדוד בגדים. זה קורה בחנות בגדים.
explanation.en: Fitting rooms and trying things on: it's a clothes shop.

items.prompt: Why was the customer charged full price?
items.audioText: Customer: This sign says thirty percent off, but you charged me full price. Cashier: Let me check. Oh, you're right. The sale started today and the system hasn't been updated yet. I'll give you back the difference.

options.text: The customer took the wrong item.

hints.he: מה הקופאי/ת מגלה אחרי Let me check?
hints.en: What does the cashier find after Let me check?

explanation.he: הקופאי/ת מסביר/ה: The sale started today and the system hasn't been updated yet. המבצע התחיל היום, והמערכת עוד לא עודכנה.
explanation.en: The sale started today, but the system hasn't been updated yet.

items.prompt: How long has Ella been ill?
items.audioText: Doctor: What seems to be the problem? Ella: I've had a sore throat and a headache since Sunday. Doctor: Any fever? Ella: Only a little, last night.

hints.he: להקשיב למילה since.
hints.en: Listen for the word since.

explanation.he: אלה אומרת I've had a sore throat and a headache since Sunday: כאב גרון וכאב ראש מיום ראשון. last night זה רק החום.
explanation.en: She has been ill since Sunday. Last night was only the fever.

items.prompt: For how long should Yoni take the pills?
items.audioText: Doctor: Take one of these pills three times a day, after meals. Yoni: Should I take them for a week? Doctor: No, just five days, even if you feel better earlier.

hints.he: מה הרופא/ה עונה לשאלה for a week?
hints.en: How does the doctor answer the question about a week?

explanation.he: יוני שואל על שבוע, והתשובה No, just five days: רק חמישה ימים. even if you feel better earlier: גם אם ירגיש טוב קודם.
explanation.en: The doctor says just five days, even if he feels better earlier.

items.prompt: How does Tom feel at the end?
items.audioText: Doctor: So how did you hurt your ankle? Tom: I was playing basketball and landed badly. Doctor: Well, it's not broken, but you need to rest it. No sport for three weeks. Tom: Three weeks? But the final is on Friday!

options.text: Upset that he will miss the final
Happy to take a break from sport

hints.he: איך טום מגיב ל־three weeks?
hints.en: How does Tom react to three weeks?

explanation.he: בסוף טום אומר Three weeks? But the final is on Friday!: הגמר ביום שישי והוא לא יוכל לשחק. הוא מאוכזב ומתוסכל.
explanation.en: Tom will miss Friday's final, so he is upset.

items.audioText: Receptionist: Good morning, Doctor Cohen's clinic. Amir: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment for tomorrow. Receptionist: Is ten thirty okay? Amir: Perfect, thanks.

hints.he: להקשיב ליום ולשעה.
hints.en: Listen for the day and the time.

explanation.he: אמיר מבקש an appointment for tomorrow (תור למחר), והפקיד/ה מציע/ה ten thirty: 10:30. אמיר עונה Perfect.
explanation.en: He asks for tomorrow and agrees to ten thirty.

items.prompt: What is Dana's message for Ron?
items.audioText: Dana: Hi, is Ron there? Dad: Sorry, he's at football practice. Can I take a message? Dana: Yes, could you tell him the meeting is at six, not five? Dad: Sure, I'll tell him.

options.text: Dana will be late for the meeting.

hints.he: מה דנה מבקשת להגיד לרון?
hints.en: What does Dana ask Dad to tell Ron?

explanation.he: דנה אומרת tell him the meeting is at six, not five: הפגישה בשש ולא בחמש. כלומר השעה השתנתה.
explanation.en: The meeting is at six, not five: the time has changed.

items.audioText: Omer: Hey, it's me. I can't find my keys. Did I leave them at your place? Tali: Wait, let me look. Yes, they're on the sofa. Omer: Phew! I'll come and get them in an hour.

options.text: To find out if his keys are at her place
To invite Tali to his house
To ask Tali to bring him the keys

hints.he: להקשיב לשאלה הראשונה של עומר.
hints.en: Listen to Omer's first question.

explanation.he: עומר שואל Did I leave them at your place? האם השארתי את המפתחות אצלך. הוא יבוא לקחת אותם בעצמו: I'll come and get them.
explanation.en: He calls to ask if his keys are at her place. He will come and get them himself.

items.audioText: Sara: Hi, Mom. Just letting you know I'll be home later than I said. Mom: How much later? Sara: The last bus left without me, so I'm walking. About forty minutes. Mom: Walking? Stay where you are. I'm getting in the car.

options.text: Sara will wait for the next bus.

hints.he: מה אמא אומרת בסוף?
hints.en: What does Mom say at the end?

explanation.he: אמא אומרת Stay where you are. I'm getting in the car: להישאר במקום, היא נכנסת לרכב. כלומר היא תאסוף את שרה. אין next bus, כי the last bus left.
explanation.en: Mom tells Sara to stay and gets in the car, so she will pick her up. There is no next bus.

items.audioText: Ben: Hi, I'm calling about the bike you're selling. Is it still available? Seller: It is. It's almost new. I've only ridden it twice. Ben: And you're asking nine hundred? Seller: That's right. Ben: Hmm, that's a bit more than I wanted to spend.

options.text: The price is too high for him.

hints.he: להקשיב למשפט האחרון של בן.
hints.en: Listen to Ben's last sentence.

explanation.he: בן אומר that's a bit more than I wanted to spend: זה קצת יותר ממה שרציתי להוציא. האופניים still available ו־almost new.
explanation.en: Ben says it's more than he wanted to spend. The bike is almost new and still available.

items.audioText: Itai: So, are we going to the Galilee or the Dead Sea? Roni: The Dead Sea will be too hot in August. Itai: Good point. The Galilee, then. We can hike near a stream.

hints.he: למה Roni לא רוצה את Dead Sea?
hints.en: Why doesn't Roni want the Dead Sea?

explanation.he: ים המלח too hot in August: חם מדי באוגוסט. איתי מסכים: Good point. The Galilee, then. הם נוסעים לגליל.
explanation.en: The Dead Sea is too hot in August, so they choose the Galilee.

items.prompt: How will they probably travel to Jerusalem?
items.audioText: Mia: How are we getting to Jerusalem? Adam: The train's quickest, but it doesn't run on Saturday. Mia: We're going on Friday morning, so that's fine.

hints.he: מתי הם נוסעים, ומתי הרכבת לא נוסעת?
hints.en: When are they going, and when doesn't the train run?

explanation.he: הרכבת quickest, הבעיה היחידה היא Saturday. הם נוסעים on Friday morning, ומיה אומרת that's fine. לכן ייסעו ברכבת.
explanation.en: The train is quickest and they go on Friday, so the train is fine.

items.prompt: Why did Gili book only three nights?
items.audioText: Gili: I booked the hostel for three nights. Yuval: Three? I thought we said four. Gili: We did, but it was full on the last night. We can camp that night. Yuval: Fine, as long as someone brings a tent.

options.text: The hostel had no room on the last night.

hints.he: מה גילי אומרת אחרי We did, but?
hints.en: What does Gili say after We did, but?

explanation.he: גילי אומרת it was full on the last night: בלילה האחרון לא היה מקום. התוכנית לא השתנתה: בלילה הזה הם יישנו באוהל.
explanation.en: The hostel was full on the last night. The plan is still four nights; they will camp on the last one.

items.prompt: What time will they leave home?
items.audioText: Ariel: What time does our flight leave? Noga: At six in the morning, so we need to be at the airport by four. Ariel: Four? Then we'd better leave home at three.

hints.he: יש שלוש שעות שונות. מה כל אחת?
hints.en: There are three times. What is each one?

explanation.he: six זו הטיסה, four זה בשדה התעופה, ו־we'd better leave home at three: כדאי לצאת מהבית בשלוש.
explanation.en: Six is the flight, four is the airport, three is leaving home.

items.audioText: Dad: Let's not plan every minute of the trip this time. Rina: But what if we get bored? Dad: Then we'll find something to do. Last year we rushed from place to place, and nobody enjoyed it.

options.text: The family should leave free time on the trip.
The trip should be shorter this year.
Last year's trip was the best one.

hints.he: Let's not plan every minute: מה אבא רוצה?
hints.en: Let's not plan every minute: what does Dad want?

explanation.he: אבא אומר Let's not plan every minute: לא לתכנן כל דקה. בשנה שעברה we rushed from place to place, and nobody enjoyed it: מיהרו ואף אחד לא נהנה.
explanation.en: Dad wants less planning, because last year they rushed and nobody enjoyed it.

items.audioText: Neta: You look upset. What's wrong? Alon: I lent my brother my laptop, and he spilled juice on it. Now it won't turn on.

options.text: Alon spilled juice on it himself.

hints.he: מי שפך את המיץ?
hints.en: Who spilled the juice?

explanation.he: אלון אומר I lent my brother my laptop, and he spilled juice on it: האח שפך מיץ, ועכשיו it won't turn on (לא נדלק).
explanation.en: Alon's brother spilled juice on it, and now it won't turn on.

items.audioText: Maya: I feel terrible. I forgot Shir's birthday. Tom: Have you called her? Maya: Not yet. I'm too embarrassed. Tom: The longer you wait, the worse it'll be. Call her now.

hints.he: מה טום אומר בסוף?
hints.en: What does Tom say at the end?

explanation.he: טום אומר The longer you wait, the worse it'll be. Call her now: ככל שמחכים זה גרוע יותר, אז להתקשר עכשיו.
explanation.en: Tom says waiting makes it worse: call her now.

items.prompt: What is Ido trying to do?
items.audioText: Ido: Are you still worried about your solo in the concert? Lihi: I've practised every day, but my hands shake just thinking about it. Ido: Everyone's nervous before going on stage. That's completely normal.

hints.he: Everyone's nervous... That's normal: למה עידו אומר את זה?
hints.en: Everyone's nervous... why does Ido say this?

explanation.he: ליהי מפחדת: my hands shake. עידו אומר Everyone's nervous... That's completely normal: כולם לחוצים וזה נורמלי. הוא מנסה להרגיע אותה.
explanation.en: Lihi is scared. Ido says everyone is nervous and it's normal, to calm her down.

items.prompt: Why might Roi's parents change their minds?
items.audioText: Roi: My parents won't let me go to the party because it ends after midnight. Dana: Did you tell them my mom is driving us home? Roi: No, I didn't think of that. Dana: Tell them. It might change their minds.

options.text: Dana's mom will drive them home.
Roi will sleep at Dana's house.

hints.he: מה רועי לא סיפר להורים?
hints.en: What didn't Roi tell his parents?

explanation.he: דנה שואלת Did you tell them my mom is driving us home? אמא של דנה תסיע אותם הביתה, וזה might change their minds. המסיבה עדיין ends after midnight.
explanation.en: Dana's mom will drive them home. The party still ends after midnight.

items.prompt: How does Ayelet feel about the long journey?
items.audioText: Ayelet: I got into the art school! Ben: Wow, I knew you would. Ayelet: It's in Tel Aviv, so I'd have to leave at six every morning. Ben: Is that a problem? Ayelet: Not compared to finally studying what I love.

options.text: It is worth it for her.
It makes her want to say no.
It is too tiring for her.

hints.he: להקשיב לתשובה האחרונה של איילת.
hints.en: Listen to Ayelet's last answer.

explanation.he: איילת אומרת Not compared to finally studying what I love: זה לא בעיה לעומת ללמוד סוף סוף את מה שהיא אוהבת. הנסיעה שווה את זה.
explanation.en: "Not compared to finally studying what I love": the journey is worth it.

items.prompt: Why does Tamar want the job?
items.audioText: Interviewer: Why do you want to work at the ice cream shop this summer? Tamar: I love working with people, and I want to save money for a trip. Interviewer: Have you worked before? Tamar: Only as a babysitter.

options.text: She likes people and wants to save money.
She needs money for school books.

hints.he: תמר נותנת שתי סיבות.
hints.en: Tamar gives two reasons.

explanation.he: תמר אומרת I love working with people (אוהבת לעבוד עם אנשים) ו־I want to save money for a trip (לחסוך כסף לטיול).
explanation.en: She loves working with people and wants to save money for a trip.

items.prompt: Is Friday a problem for the job?
items.audioText: Interviewer: The job is from eight to two, five days a week. Can you do that? Eitan: Yes, except Fridays. I help my grandfather in his shop then. Interviewer: That's fine. We're closed on Fridays anyway.

options.text: No, because the shop is closed on Fridays.
Yes, so Eitan can't get the job.
No, because Eitan's grandfather will work instead.

hints.he: מה המראיין/ת אומר/ת בסוף?
hints.en: What does the interviewer say at the end?

explanation.he: איתן לא יכול בימי שישי, אבל המראיין/ת עונה We're closed on Fridays anyway: ממילא סגור בשישי. לכן זו לא בעיה.
explanation.en: The interviewer says they are closed on Fridays anyway, so it's not a problem.

items.prompt: What can we understand about Noa?
items.audioText: Interviewer: The camp starts at seven thirty. Are you an early riser? Noa: Honestly, not really. But I set two alarms, and I've never been late for school. Interviewer: I like your honesty.

options.text: She is honest about her weak points.
She is often late for school.

hints.he: Honestly, not really: מה נועה מודה?
hints.en: Honestly, not really: what does Noa admit?

explanation.he: נועה מודה Honestly, not really: היא לא אוהבת לקום מוקדם, ובכל זאת I've never been late. המראיין/ת אומר/ת I like your honesty.
explanation.en: Noa admits she isn't an early riser but is never late. The interviewer likes her honesty.

items.prompt: About how much will Gal earn in a week?
items.audioText: Interviewer: We pay forty shekels an hour, and you'll work about twenty hours a week. Gal: That sounds good. When would I start? Interviewer: On the first of July, if you're free.

hints.he: כמה לשעה, וכמה שעות בשבוע?
hints.en: How much per hour, and how many hours a week?

explanation.he: forty shekels an hour (40 לשעה) כפול twenty hours a week (20 שעות בשבוע): 40 כפול 20 זה 800.
explanation.en: 40 shekels an hour x 20 hours = about 800 shekels a week.

items.prompt: Why is Yoav a good fit for the job?
items.audioText: Interviewer: Tell me a little about yourself. Yoav: I'm sixteen, I'm on the school swimming team, and I've done a lifeguard course. Interviewer: Great. That's exactly what we need at the pool.

options.text: He has done a lifeguard course.
He is the oldest person who applied.
He has worked at the pool before.

hints.he: מה יואב עשה שמתאים לבריכה?
hints.en: What has Yoav done that is useful at a pool?

explanation.he: יואב אומר I've done a lifeguard course: עשה קורס מציל. המראיין/ת עונה That's exactly what we need at the pool.
explanation.en: He has done a lifeguard course, which is exactly what the pool needs.

items.prompt: How often would Rotem work at weekends?
items.audioText: Interviewer: Do you have any questions for us? Rotem: Yes. Would I need to work at weekends? Interviewer: One Saturday night a month, at most. Rotem: That's fine with me.

options.text: One Saturday night a month at most

hints.he: להקשיב לתשובה של המראיין/ת.
hints.en: Listen to the interviewer's answer.

explanation.he: המראיין/ת עונה One Saturday night a month, at most: לכל היותר מוצאי שבת אחד בחודש.
explanation.en: At most one Saturday night a month.

items.audioText: Waiter: Are you ready to order? Ofir: Yes, a vegetable salad and an orange juice, please. Waiter: I'm sorry, we've run out of orange juice. Ofir: Then lemonade, please.

hints.he: מה קרה למיץ התפוזים?
hints.en: What happened to the orange juice?

explanation.he: המלצר/ית אומר/ת we've run out of orange juice: נגמר מיץ התפוזים. לכן אופיר מזמין Then lemonade: לימונדה.
explanation.en: They've run out of orange juice, so Ofir orders lemonade.

items.prompt: How much will Adi pay for Friday night?
items.audioText: Receptionist: Good evening, Sea View Hotel. Adi: Hi, I booked a room for Thursday, but I need to change it to Friday. Receptionist: Friday's fine, but it's three hundred shekels instead of two hundred and fifty. Adi: That's okay.

hints.he: instead of: איזה מחיר הוא החדש?
hints.en: instead of: which price is the new one?

explanation.he: הפקיד/ה אומר/ת three hundred shekels instead of two hundred and fifty: שלוש מאות במקום מאתיים וחמישים. 250 זה המחיר של יום חמישי.
explanation.en: Friday costs 300 instead of 250. 250 was the Thursday price.

items.audioText: Mom: Did you pack your swimsuit? Eli: Yes, and my towel. Mom: What about sun cream? Eli: Oh, I forgot! I'll get it now.

hints.he: על מה אלי עונה Oh, I forgot?
hints.en: What is Eli answering when he says Oh, I forgot?

explanation.he: את swimsuit ו־towel הוא ארז: Yes, and my towel. כשאמא שואלת What about sun cream? הוא עונה Oh, I forgot!: שכח קרם הגנה.
explanation.en: He packed the swimsuit and towel but forgot the sun cream.

items.prompt: Why doesn't Ofek want to try out for the team?
items.audioText: Ofek: I don't think I'll try out for the team. Hadar: Why not? You're one of the best players I know. Ofek: Last year I didn't get in, and I don't want to feel like that again. Hadar: But you're much better now.

options.text: He is afraid of failing again.
He doesn't like the other players.
He thinks he plays badly now.

hints.he: I don't want to feel like that again: איך הוא הרגיש?
hints.en: I don't want to feel like that again: how did he feel?

explanation.he: אופק אומר Last year I didn't get in: בשנה שעברה לא התקבל, ו־I don't want to feel like that again: הוא מפחד מעוד כישלון.
explanation.en: He didn't get in last year and doesn't want to feel that way again: he is afraid of failing.

items.audioText: Pharmacist: Here you are. These drops are for your eyes. Mor: My eyes? The doctor said ear drops. Pharmacist: Let me check the prescription. You're right, it says ear drops. I'll get you the right ones.

hints.he: מה רשום במרשם?
hints.en: What does the prescription say?

explanation.he: הרוקח/ת בודק/ת: it says ear drops (רשום: טיפות לאוזניים), ומבטיח/ה I'll get you the right ones: להביא את הנכונות, טיפות אוזניים.
explanation.en: The prescription says ear drops, so the pharmacist will get the right ones: ear drops.

items.prompt: What is the principal's attitude to the new rule?
items.audioText: Principal: From next month, phones must stay in lockers during lessons. Student: During lessons? What if our parents need us? Principal: They can call the office, just like parents did before phones existed.

hints.he: המנהל/ת משנה דעה אחרי השאלה?
hints.en: Does the principal change their mind after the question?

explanation.he: המנהל/ת עונה מיד They can call the office: יש פתרון, והכלל נשאר. הוא/היא לא מהסס/ת ולא מוותר/ת, כלומר נחרץ/ה.
explanation.en: The principal answers at once with a solution and keeps the rule: firm.

items.prompt: How much will each of them pay?
items.audioText: Liat: Let's take the cable car up the mountain. Erez: How much is it? Liat: Fifty shekels for adults, and half price for students. Erez: Great, we're both students.

hints.he: half price for students: והם סטודנטים?
hints.en: half price for students: are they students?

explanation.he: למבוגרים fifty shekels (50), half price for students: חצי מחיר לסטודנטים. ארז אומר we're both students, אז כל אחד משלם 25.
explanation.en: Students pay half of 50, and they are both students: 25 each.
